title: Mother/Donor Plant Management & Plant Identity
description: Specialist module covering donor accession identity, suitability, stock-area biosecurity, donor-linked performance analysis, testing status, lifecycle records and replacement decisions.
learningOutcomes: Establish and maintain reconstructable donor identity and genealogy from accession through cutting collection and downstream batch assignment.
Evaluate donor suitability using source identity, developmental condition, plant-health evidence, propagation performance history and defined acceptance criteria.
Apply stock-area biosecurity boundaries that separate clean, incoming, suspect and held donor material while preserving tool, personnel and movement controls.
Analyze donor-linked propagation performance without confusing correlation, genotype effects, plant condition and shared process/environment effects.
Design a donor lifecycle and replacement record that preserves provenance, testing status, performance trend, exceptions and disposition decisions without unsupported clean-stock claims.
